name: Luk
source:
"Will you please accompany me in my lifelong redemption?"

He is in charge of Yvet's security at the request of The Ghost. 
Formerly a member of the Web, he has a well-trained physique, calm judgment, and high combat ability.
He has a rugged and serious personality, but he is also a man of strong character, having been through many ordeals in his life.
On the other hand, he is not familiar with the latest IT technology and relies exclusively on his younger brother, Shawn, for information gathering.
He started working as a bodyguard to atone for his failure to save a young child due to his overconfidence in himself.
